ops.text: TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF CLIENT DATA. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to 6 months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within 30 days of such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client Content and other Client data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Client Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a transition-assistance and data-return clause, as the Agreement gives us no right to our own hosted data or migration help on exit. The 30-day return deadline now runs from expiration or termination (not from a later request) and the data comes back in a standard machine-readable format, with deletion certified thereafter.
proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance (up to 6 months at then-current rates), return of Client data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter.
